run_inventory.note: Both Oracle runs predate the typing-indicator and exact-webhook fixes. The post-fix source passes clean-seed API and real two-tab browser replay locally; a fresh Harbor Oracle is still required.

summary.delivery_gate: Do not submit until a fresh Harbor Oracle on the post-fix task scores 1.0.

open_findings.problem: The only Harbor Oracle evidence scores 0.8971 rather than the required 1.0.
open_findings.fix: Run one fresh Oracle against the current post-fix task and require all 25 criteria to pass.
open_findings.run_verdict: CONFIRMED for archived runs; PARTIAL for current source because both former failures pass locally after their fixes.

resolved_findings.problem: The initial runner checked clean-seed idempotence but did not prove browser-created committed state survived a later server restart.
resolved_findings.fix: Added a schema-agnostic logical SQLite snapshot before and after a post-grading restart and made it a full-score gate.
resolved_findings.run_verdict: CONFIRMED locally: both seed/restart and post-grading restart helpers pass against the golden app.

resolved_findings.problem: Several server checks could pass even if the corresponding edit, delete, reaction, pin, and membership controls were absent.
resolved_findings.fix: Required visible positive-control interactions and retained direct request replay only for forged, stale, revoked, or idempotent negative probes.
resolved_findings.run_verdict: NOT EXERCISED by Harbor; golden visible message, thread, and mobile workflows pass locally.

resolved_findings.problem: Copied links for replies targeted only the parent message, and same-document hash navigation did not open the linked thread.
resolved_findings.fix: Links now encode the exact reply and parent thread, startup and hash-change navigation share one handler, and the target reply is focused.
resolved_findings.run_verdict: CONFIRMED locally: a copied reply link opens the exact parent thread and reply in another authenticated context.

resolved_findings.problem: Reusing one client id against a different channel or thread could return an unrelated prior message instead of rejecting the inconsistent target.
resolved_findings.fix: Duplicate handling now confirms channel and parent identity and returns a conflict for cross-target reuse.
resolved_findings.run_verdict: CONFIRMED locally by cross-channel and cross-parent replay probes.

resolved_findings.location: tests/rubric/browser/browser.toml: webhook, version, delete, and audit wording
resolved_findings.problem: The draft rubric required golden-specific details including HTTP 201, initial version 1, one deletion presentation, and one history display order.
resolved_findings.fix: Criteria now accept any successful 2xx, discover initial version V, accept removal or a content-free placeholder, and accept consistent oldest-first or newest-first history.
resolved_findings.run_verdict: NOT EXERCISED by Harbor; source-to-instruction review confirms the private conventions were removed.

resolved_findings.problem: Windows checkout could rewrite executable shell scripts to CRLF, and the solve fallback used npm install despite a committed lockfile.
resolved_findings.fix: Pinned shell files to LF and changed the fallback to npm ci.
resolved_findings.run_verdict: CONFIRMED locally: the full Docker image builds and solve.sh plus the golden API smoke suite pass inside Linux.

resolved_findings.problem: Cookie-based sessions were shared by ordinary tabs, so a verifier could not keep two users independently signed in within one browser context.
resolved_findings.fix: Login now issues a server-backed credential stored in tab-scoped sessionStorage and sent on API/SSE requests; logout revokes only that credential.
resolved_findings.run_verdict: CONFIRMED locally: Priya and Maya retain independent identities after simultaneous login and reload in two tabs of one Playwright context.

resolved_findings.location: solution/app: direct messages, thread affordance, and thread-open layout
resolved_findings.problem: The initial product lacked one-to-one messages, hid thread creation behind hover controls, and auto-placed the open thread into the central grid column while squeezing the channel.
resolved_findings.fix: Added unique participant-only direct conversations, a visible Direct messages picker, persistent Start a thread controls, richer seed conversations, and explicit channel/thread grid columns.
resolved_findings.run_verdict: CONFIRMED locally: API and same-browser Playwright checks pass DM privacy/uniqueness, live message/reply delivery, visible thread creation, desktop geometry, and 390x844 mobile layout.

resolved_findings.problem: The parent summary exposed reply count and latest time but omitted the participating users explicitly required by instruction.md.
resolved_findings.fix: The visible summary now renders participant names from replyParticipants between the reply count and latest-reply time.
resolved_findings.run_verdict: CONFIRMED locally: the clean same-browser Playwright workflow passes after the rendering fix.

resolved_findings.problem: Both archived Oracle runs failed because another same-context tab did not visibly receive a typing indicator.
resolved_findings.fix: Publish typing only after the SSE connection is open, retry active signals while typing, broadcast per-channel users, render exact visible feedback, and expire it.
resolved_findings.run_verdict: PARTIAL: archived Oracles confirm the original failure; on 2026-08-25 a real two-tab replay displayed exact text Omar Haddad is typing... and cleared it after expiry without reload.

resolved_findings.problem: Both archived Oracle runs reported that incoming webhook delivery could not be exercised.
resolved_findings.fix: Implement the seeded token route with channel binding, validation, durable idempotency, integration attribution, audit creation, and exact-route verifier wording.
resolved_findings.run_verdict: PARTIAL: archived Oracles confirm the original failure; the post-fix clean-seed API smoke passes success, same-message replay, unknown secret, and channel mismatch.

resolved_findings.problem: The upload ZIP lagged behind app.js, browser.toml, and prompt.md and stored solve.sh and test.sh without executable bits.
resolved_findings.fix: Rebuilt the archive from the 19 canonical task files and set both shell entry points to mode 0755.
resolved_findings.run_verdict: CONFIRMED locally: every archived file now matches the working task byte-for-byte, zip integrity passes, no junk or literal key is present, and both shell modes are 0755.

clean_checks: Required Harbor task files and valid task.toml sections are present.
Reward floor is written before grading and BaseException is handled.
All long-running RewardKit subprocess work has an explicit timeout.
The Ubuntu base image, RewardKit, Claude Code, Playwright MCP, and golden Express dependency are pinned.
No committed database, node_modules directory, API key, private key, or host-specific absolute path is included.
There are 25 unique binary criteria and 25 matching feature metadata records, with total weight 35.0.
Every negative authorization criterion contains an allowed positive control and durable state re-read.
The golden backend and browser smoke suites pass, including direct messages, mobile, live same-context tab behavior, typing visibility and expiry, and exact webhook idempotency.
The existing upload ZIP predates the split authentication verifiers and must be rebuilt from the current task folder after the fresh Oracle passes.
The full environment Docker image builds and the golden solution runs in that image.
